'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Seth Acree DS Imperial Occupation''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Seth Acree]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''Dark'''. Handwritten. Line 6 Victory → Victory-Class Star Destroyer; line 22 '''Black Leader''' → DS-61-2; line 24 Marquand In Blizzard 6 → Colonel Marquand In Blizzard 6; line 28 '''Ni Chuba Naa??''' → Ni Chuba Na? (V). Line 48 Alert My Star Destroyer noted non-V on sheet.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Imperial Occupation|Imperial Occupation (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
